assumptions: OpenTsiolkovsky 1.0.0 (MIT, external binary -- not vendored; see NOTICE; openTsiolkovsky-v1.0.0-<platform>.tar.gz, pinned per-platform SHA-256 digests live in scripts/fetch_opentsiolkovsky.py)
OT pos_eci_*/vel_eci_* read as LAUNCH_ECI (axes = ECEF at the launch epoch, held inertial) and converted to GCRS by orbitopt.flightlab.frames.to_gcrs at the epoch
created_utc is the mission epoch: this adapter is a pure function of (target, vehicle, attitude program), so repeated calls write byte-identical runs

vehicle: E5-05a redesign (task #285): stage-1 propellant load 590 t (2x the sealed 350 t) and a declared burn_end_s cutoff at 134 s (depletion-independent), so MECO/separation carry a COMPUTED 136.7 t separation mass = 106.7 t RTLS propellant reserve instead of burning to depletion; the recovery chain plans from this computed state and the propellant-reserve gate PASSES (13.6 t at touchdown, docs/adr/flightlab-0008).

vehicle: Stage-1 tube widened to 5.2 m for the 2x propellant load; same Cd(Mach) table and same 30 t dry mass as the sealed baseline; lofted MECO (elevation 44 deg at burn end, burn extended to 134 s) carries separation to ~90 km / 2.3 km/s / 120 km downrange - the ~180 t-class separation regime task

vehicle: Stage-2 12 t dry (0.935 mass fraction, C/LiAl class), 85 t wet, 6.2->2.8 MN lazy profile: burnout flight-path angle is the binding constraint (F6/F9): the reference flight reaches rp -0.74 km / ra 5696 km at SECO, the best perigee the OpenTsiolkovsky 1.1.0 single-burn backend achieves from a reserve-carrying separation state; closing the 250 km insertion band needs a coast/restart capability the backend does not expose (F9, docs/adr/flightlab-0008).
vehicle: Landing reserve 15 t (planning margin carried by the booster model); the graded minimum is the flight target's recovery.min_propellant_reserve_kg.
vehicle: Derived-not-copied design: campaign + recovery-budget provenance in docs/adr/flightlab-0008.

target: E5-05a redesign target: the ascent must reach MECO with a computed (not depleted) stage-1 propellant reserve and still insert at the 250 km reference orbit; the RTLS recovery chain plans from that computed separation state.
target: Max-acceleration ceiling relaxed to 15 g (uncrewed cargo design assumption); max-q kept at the sealed 60 kPa value.

target: Recovery plan overrides (entry_q_max_pa 250 kPa, max_fevals 140 on the frozen FL-305 start) are per-plan options carried by the mission file's recovery.plan_options, not target constraints; the entry-g ceiling stays at the default 8 g. See docs/adr/flightlab-0008.
